Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: Request to go to sleep has been accepted or sleep transition is already in progress or controller is already in sleep state E_ NOT_ OK: Request to go to sleep has not been accepted due to one or more of the following reasons: - LIN Interface has not been initialized - referenced channel does not exist (identification is out of range) Description Initiates a transition into the Sleep Mode on the selected channel. Available via Lin If.h
